## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Preis und Paywall.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 03.05.2026 - 17.05.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Marc Anderson_, 17.05.2026, 1/5: "I paid for the premium for life version, now the app shows me ads and locks me out of widgets saying I need premium. update 2 months later: still no fix. the email I was advised to contact stopped responding after I sent two different forms of proof of purchase. I sent a inquiry more recently to check in and no response. the app still randomly shows adds, widget stops updating or it says subscribe to premium. edit 2: now at 10 months with no further resolution or response."
            2. _Fabrizio_, 03.05.2026, 1/5: "premium ad abbonamento settimanale da 15€, follia. Parliamo di 60€ al mese, 720€ l'anno. mi costa di meno la macchina. Prezzo ingiustificato per qualsiasi app. Dal paywall non si capisce neanche quali funzionalità verrebbero sbloccate oltre a rimuovere le pubblicità."
